errors.message: sticky "a": before "b" is a sticky that is not a direct child of page "p1". `before` orders siblings in the same FLOW region: name one of "g".
before: "b" is listed twice.

sticky "a": `before` is legal only on a direct child of a `layout FLOW` region, and page "p1" is AUTO (the default): write `layout FLOW` on it to order its children by `before`, or use ROW, COLUMN or GRID, which keep the written order.

sticky "a": `before` is legal only on a direct child of a `layout FLOW` region, and page "p1" is ROW: ROW already keeps the children in the order they are written, so reorder them, or choose `layout FLOW`.
sticky "a": `before` names itself. A child comes before its siblings, not itself.
fill: expected a hex colour like "#ffcc00" or one of red, blue, green, yellow, purple, orange, pink, white, black, gray, got "chartreuse".
columns: expected a whole number of columns, 1 or more, got 1.5.
section "s": item 2 is `connector`, which is not a member of section. It holds: sticky, shape, textbox, group. Connectors are written directly in the page.
connector "ab" is on page "p1" but its to "b" is a sticky on page "p2". A connector joins marks on the same page: put the connector and both marks on one page, or connect a mark on page "p1".
page "p1": `direction` is legal only with `layout FLOW`, e.g. `page [ … ] id "steps" layout FLOW direction DOWN {}`.
id "a" is used by a sticky on page "p1" and again by a shape on page "p1". Ids are unique across the whole board: rename one, e.g. id "a-2".
sticky "a": needs `text`, e.g. sticky id "idea" text "Idea" {}.

page "p1": item 2 is `text`, which is not a member of page. It holds: sticky, shape, textbox, section, group, connector. If `text` belongs to the description before it, a `{}` ended that description early: a description ends in exactly one `{}`, after its last word.
A board needs at least one page, e.g. board [ page [ ] id "p1" name "Page 1" {} ] {}.
connector "c": to "zz" names nothing on the board. A connector joins two marks by their ids: give the mark `id "zz"`, or use the id it has.
connector "c": from "s" is a section. A connector joins stickies, shapes and textboxes: name a mark inside it instead.
sticky "a": `fontSize` is not a property of sticky. It takes: id, text, fill, opacity, font-size, before. Write it as `font-size`.

sticky "a": `width` is not a property of sticky. It takes: id, text, fill, opacity, font-size, before. L0187 computes placement, so `width` is not a word: arrange content with `layout` (ROW, COLUMN, GRID with `columns`, or FLOW with `direction` and `before`) on the page, section or group that holds it, e.g. `group [ … ] id "cards" layout GRID columns 3 {}`.

sticky "a": `x` is not a property of sticky. It takes: id, text, fill, opacity, font-size, before. L0187 computes placement, so `x` is not a word: arrange content with `layout` (ROW, COLUMN, GRID with `columns`, or FLOW with `direction` and `before`) on the page, section or group that holds it, e.g. `group [ … ] id "cards" layout GRID columns 3 {}`.
page "p1": `layout GRID` needs `columns`, e.g. `page [ … ] id "cards" layout GRID columns 3 {}`.
group "g": `columns` is legal only with `layout GRID`, e.g. `group [ … ] id "cards" layout GRID columns 3 {}`. The legal settings of a group are: id, layout, direction, columns, before.
textbox "t": `fill` is not a property of textbox. It takes: id, text, color, opacity, font-size, before. `fill` belongs to: sticky, shape, section.

sticky "t": the character '漢' (U+6F22) has no glyph in FIGJAM_V1's font, so it cannot be measured. Write the text with characters FIGJAM_V1 supports (Latin, Greek and Cyrillic scripts, common symbols and emoji).
sticky: needs `id`, e.g. sticky id "idea" text "Idea" {}.
page "p1": needs `name`, e.g. page [ sticky id "idea" text "Idea" {} ] id "p1" name "Ideas" {}.
sticky "a": needs `text`, e.g. sticky id "idea" text "Idea" {}.
A program is one board, ending in `..`: e.g. board [ page [ sticky id "a" text "Hello" {} ] id "p1" name "Page 1" {} ] {}..
page "p1": item 1 is "hello", which is not a member of page. It holds: sticky, shape, textbox, section, group, connector.
id: an id is a quoted string, like "idea"; got 7.
opacity: expected a number from 0 to 100, got 150.
A board with more than one page cannot hide both its page tabs and its page menu: drop `show-page-tabs false` or write `show-page-menu true`.

kind: expected one of SQUARE, ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, ELLIPSE, DIAMOND, PARALLELOGRAM_RIGHT, PREDEFINED_PROCESS, DOCUMENT_SINGLE, ENG_DATABASE, got "diamond". Write it bare and uppercase, without quotes: kind DIAMOND.

Undefined reference 'x'. L0187 computes placement, so `x` is not a word: arrange content with `layout` (ROW, COLUMN, GRID with `columns`, or FLOW with `direction` and `before`) on the page, section or group that holds it, e.g. `group [ … ] id "cards" layout GRID columns 3 {}`.
Undefined reference 'stamp'. `stamp` is not part of L0187.
text: is given twice. Each property appears once in a description.

textbox "t": the character 'ש' (U+05E9) is right-to-left text, which FIGJAM_V1 does not lay out. Write the text with characters FIGJAM_V1 supports (Latin, Greek and Cyrillic scripts, common symbols and emoji).
save-to-figjam: expected a FigJam link like "https://www.figma.com/board/ABC123/Name" or a bare file key like "ABC123", got "nope".
page "p1": item 1 is save-to-figjam, which is not a member of page. Write `save-to-figjam "<file key or link>"` on its own line before the board.
save-to-figjam is given twice. A board is drawn into one FigJam file: keep one save-to-figjam line.
section "inner" is inside section "outer" (through a group). A section cannot hold another section, at any depth: make the inner one a group, or move it out beside "outer".
section "outer": item 1 is `section`, which is not a member of section. It holds: sticky, shape, textbox, group. A section cannot hold another section.
id: "*" is reserved and cannot be an id or a reference.

The `before` orders in page "cycle" form a cycle: a -> b -> a. Strict order cannot loop. Remove `before` from one of "a", "b"; a connector can still show the return path, e.g. connector id "b-a" from "b" to "a" {}.

The `before` orders in page "p1" form a cycle: a -> b -> c -> a. Strict order cannot loop. Remove `before` from one of "a", "b", "c"; a connector can still show the return path, e.g. connector id "c-a" from "c" to "a" {}.
textbox "long": its text is 4004 characters, and FIGJAM_V1 lays out at most 4000 per text. Split it across several marks.
Too few arguments for TEXT. Expected 2. `text` takes a value and then the rest of its description: every description ends in `{}` after its last word, e.g. `sticky id "a" text "A" {}`.
id: an id must not start or end with white space; write "a".
kind: expected one of SQUARE, ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, ELLIPSE, DIAMOND, PARALLELOGRAM_RIGHT, PREDEFINED_PROCESS, DOCUMENT_SINGLE, ENG_DATABASE, got ROW. ROW is a layout tag.
